contract.name: Rate Sheet for Travel Agent 2026/2027 – All Market FIT & GIT
contract.cancellation_text: Cancelation policy: Group bookings one-month prior notice. FIT bookings seven days prior notice.
contract.payment_text: Payment terms: payments on booked basis to be settled prior to guest arrival if not credit approved.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "Mirage Colombo all Market 2026-2027 Winter Summer Rate.pdf" (3 pages), saved to the HOTEL RATES folder on 2 Oct 2026. Page 3 is photographs only. No date printed on the sheet (PDF file created 21 Sep 2026). Travel Agent – Local Travel Agents; Market – All Market FIT & GIT; "All Countries". Rate table rows Single / Double-Twin / Triple / Family (4 pax) entered as SGL / DBL / TPL / QUAD of one base room, Standard City View (the room the Deluxe +15 / Super Deluxe +25 supplements are "on top of"). The sheet's room list also names Deluxe Triple and Deluxe family but gives them no price of their own, so the Triple and Family (4 pax) rows are taken as occupancies of the same table, not separate room types. Extra bed US$20 per night. If required, dinner for Indian national guests/groups US$12 pp at a separate location. Conference charges entered as extras.
contract.tax_note: Inclusive of all taxes: rate table says 28.75%, footer says "inclusive of 36% Tax, VAT and service charge". Non-commissionable; government rate/tax changes apply.
contract.child_policy_text: Child meal policy: 1 Child below 04 years sharing with parents FOC. Children between 05 to 11 years sharing with parents 50% of adult meal rate chargeable. Children at the age 11 & above adult meal rate chargeable.
contract.guide_policy_text: Local Guide Room Rate USD 55 on BB.
contract.foc_policy_text: Every 11th room FOC on booked basics [basis]. Local Guide Room Rate USD 55 on BB.
contract.terms_text: Please note that above non-commissionable rates are inclusive of 36% Tax, VAT and service charge and any Rate, tax changes made by the government will be applicable for the above. Conference facility and inclusives: free WiFi, screen, podium, FM mike, clip-on mike, sounds, oil lamp, white board with marker pens, flip chart, note pads, pencils, mint, water bottles and registration table.
contract.source_file: Mirage Colombo all Market 2026-2027 Winter Summer Rate.pdf
